## Labs (findings — one line each)

- Phishing Header Forensics — sending domain had no usable SPF/DKIM/DMARC; origin traced to hosting ISP, not the claimed mail provider. https://jpcarpenter.com/labs/phishing-header-forensics
- Network Segmentation — ping proves reachability not segmentation; decremented TTL confirmed inter-VLAN routing. https://jpcarpenter.com/labs/network-segmentation
- Browser exposure — repeat visitor recognition without cookies is local-only, disclosed, and revocable on this site. https://jpcarpenter.com/labs/browser-exposure
- Risk Gauge — needle and written rating share one computation (GRC instrument). https://jpcarpenter.com/labs/risk-gauge
- TINKER-SCOPE — no charting library; knobs drive real parameters. https://jpcarpenter.com/labs/tinker-scope
